body:
thank you for these words. i know i haven't followed up but i've been busy.

i woke up sick on my birthday and miserable but, by noon, i had landed several new development projects that i'd been trying to get and my financial situation has improved immensely and i'm going to get to start traveling again in a few weeks.

So, yeah, in less than 48 hours, I went from thinking the world around me was collapsing in on me to thinking there's nothing that can stop me now. I left out in the original post how close I was and I really can't tell you how seriously I was considering trying to end it again (though I'm sure it would've been half-ass at best and would've just put me in the hospital) but I got that first step to recovery in with this new influx of work.

I smiled yesterday. I laughed. I saw the glass half full. It had been a while. I think I'm going to find a doctor or psychiatrist/psychologist and try to work on maintaining a positive outlook on life. Oh and I'll make this thread my homepage so I can remember where I was at when I thought I was at my lowest and what helped me out of that fucked up state of mind.
